title: Among schools in Los Angeles County that serve grades K–12 and have an SAT
question: Among schools in Los Angeles County that serve grades K–12 and have an SAT excellence rate above 0.15, find the one with the highest eligible free meal rate for students aged 5–17. Return its name, mailing city, administrator’s first name, charter status (Yes/No), and whether it is a magnet school.

prediction.sql:
SELECT
    s."XCL_047" AS name,
    s."XCL_055" AS mailing_city,
    s."XCL_080" AS administrator_first_name,
    CASE WHEN s."XCL_063" = 1 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS charter_status,
    CASE WHEN s."XCL_077" = 1 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS magnet_school
FROM schools AS s
JOIN frpm AS f ON s."XCL_041" = f."XCL_001"
JOIN satscores AS t ON s."XCL_041" = t."XCL_030"
WHERE s."XCL_045" = 'Los Angeles'
  AND s."XCL_074" = 'K-12'
  AND CAST(t."XCL_040" AS REAL) / t."XCL_036" > 0.15
ORDER BY CAST(f."XCL_025" AS REAL) / f."XCL_024" DESC
LIMIT 1
